notes: Stories created for Server-Side Scope Enforcement aligned to tool_router allowlist dispatch.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for scope enforcement
Added unit and integration tests story

stories.title: Define Scope Enforcement Schema and Allowlist Contract
stories.description: Define a strict allowlist schema for tool access including tool name, permitted scopes, and validation rules. Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic tool models and enforce contract validation before execution.

stories.title: Implement Core Scope Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to validate incoming tool calls against the defined allowlist and scope rules. Reject any tool invocation that falls outside permitted scope boundaries before reaching domain services.

stories.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement into Tool Router Dispatch Flow
stories.description: Embed scope validation into the existing tool_router dispatch pipeline so that all Anthropic tool_use calls are intercepted and validated prior to execution. Ensure no bypass paths exist.

stories.title: Standardize Scope Violation Error Handling and API Response
stories.description: Define and return consistent error responses for scope violations, including safe messaging to the LLM and logging for debugging. Ensure no sensitive system details are exposed.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating that allowed tool calls succeed and out-of-scope calls are blocked. Include edge cases such as malformed inputs, unauthorized tool names, and bypass attempts through crafted tool_use payloads.
